units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:11">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 6:7">Num. VI, 7</cite>) <he>קראו הכתוב עטרה לראשו</he> the text calls it (his long hair which defaces him) a crown on his head.
<cite ref="Numbers 6:7">Ib.</cite> <he>נִזְרוֹ כקרבן</he> his hair is as sacred as the sacrifice; a. fr.

senses.gloss: = נְזִירוּת, the Nazarite’s vow. Num. R. l. c.; Tosef. Naz. II, 6 (ref. to Num. VI, 21) ולא נ׳ על קרבנו but not the vow to follow the dedication of his sacrifice; Y. ib. II, 52ᵇ top שיקדום נזרו וכ׳ his vow must precede the dedication of his sacrifice &c. Ib. V, 54ᵃ גילגל בנזרו he turned around (trifled with) his vow.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 90a:6">Ned. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>נשאל על נזרו</he>, v. <cite ref="U00030"><he>שָׁאַל</he></cite>; a. fr.
